prompt: Create a vertical fantasy illustration of an ethereal celestial goddess made of glowing stardust and flowing light, floating gracefully in deep space. She has a serene feminine face in side profile with closed eyes, an elegant slender body, and long weightless hair that streams leftward and upward like luminous ribbons. Her form is semi-transparent and constructed from intricate filaments, constellations, sparkles, and liquid energy lines in violet and magenta, with strong accents of cyan and warm gold. She wears a flowing, dress-like aura rather than solid clothing, with countless ribbon trails cascading downward and around her body. One arm extends softly to the right, releasing a bright magical starburst from her fingertips, while the other arm drifts downward. Surround her with swirling orbital arcs, nebula mist, tiny stars, glitter particles, and scattered glowing planets against a dark indigo cosmic background. Use a highly detailed luminous digital painting style, soft bloom, radiant rim lighting, delicate linework, dreamy atmosphere, elegant motion, high contrast, and a magical otherworldly mood. No text, no border, no watermark.
